App.Name: Voicemeeter Windows Volume Modern
Bindings.Description: Select the Voicemeeter strips and buses that should follow Windows volume and mute changes.
Settings.Updates.Title: Updates
Settings.Updates.CheckingMessage: Comparing this installation with the latest GitHub release.
Settings.Updates.AvailableMessage: A newer version than {0} is ready to download from GitHub.
Settings.Updates.CurrentMessage: Version {0} is the latest available release.
Settings.Updates.FailedMessage: The latest GitHub release could not be checked. Your current version is {0}.
Settings.Control.Title: Control
Settings.Control.RefreshDescription: Update app, audio and Voicemeeter status.
Settings.Control.ConnectionDescription: Connect or disconnect the native Voicemeeter client.
Settings.Control.ShowDescription: Bring the Voicemeeter window to the foreground.
Settings.Control.RestartDescription: Ask Voicemeeter to restart its audio engine.
Settings.Appearance.Title: Appearance
Settings.Appearance.LogoDescription: Applies to the sidebar, title bar, taskbar and tray icon.
Settings.Appearance.LayoutDescription: Choose compact centered pages or expanded full-width pages.
Settings.Appearance.LanguageDescription: Choose the language used by the app.
Settings.Appearance.HideSupportDescripti: Remove the donation page from the navigation sidebar.
Settings.Startup.Title: Startup and sync
Settings.Startup.WindowsDescription: Launch the app when the user signs in.
Settings.Startup.TrayDescription: Keep syncing in the background when the window is closed.
Settings.Startup.MuteDescription: Mirror Windows mute changes to selected Voicemeeter targets.
Settings.Startup.VolumeDescription: Keep the last known Windows volume available for recovery.
Settings.Mapping.Title: Volume mapping
Settings.Mapping.LimitDescription: Prevent mapped volume from applying positive gain.
Settings.Mapping.LinearDescription: Map Windows volume using a linear gain curve.
Settings.Mapping.MinimumDescription: Gain applied when Windows volume is at the lowest level.
Settings.Mapping.MaximumDescription: Gain applied when Windows volume reaches 100%.
Settings.Mapping.PollingDescription: Interval used only when event callbacks cannot provide updates.
Settings.Advanced.Title: Advanced settings
Settings.Advanced.SpikesDescription: Revert unexpected jumps to 100%. Engine restarts always restore the last safe level.
Settings.Advanced.DeviceTitle: Restart engine when audio devices change
Settings.Advanced.DeviceDescription: Ask Voicemeeter to recover after default device changes.
Settings.Advanced.AnyDeviceTitle: Restart engine when any device changes
Settings.Advanced.AnyDeviceDescription: Use a broader recovery path for unstable audio device setups.
Settings.Advanced.ResumeDescription: Recover Voicemeeter after Windows wakes from sleep.
About.ModernDescription: Updated, rewrited, fixed and modernized by Matheus Heidemann (heide-oficial)
Support.Title: Support me
Support.Message: If you enjoy the app and would like to support its continued development, you can make a donation through Ko-fi. Every contribution, no matter the amount, helps me dedicate more time to improving the app, fixing issues, and building new features. Thank you so much for your support! It truly helps keep the project moving forward.
Support.StarTitle: Support by starring the GitHub repository
Support.StarMessage:
If you enjoy the app and want to support the project, consider giving the repository a star on GitHub. It’s a simple way to show your support, help the project gain visibility, and make it easier for others to discover.

Thank you for supporting the project!
Support.ShowcaseMessage:
If you create a video about the app, I’d be happy to help give it more visibility. Once your video is published, open an issue on GitHub and send me the link. I may feature your video on the project page, helping promote your content while you help introduce the app to more people.

It’s a simple way for us to support each other: you showcase the app, and I help showcase your work.
